items.title: Bill Huntington Interview, 1961-12-27
items.q: and felt that they were pretty poor musicians, even Baby. Yeah, I think he used to call Baby the iron foundry or something.

ctx.x: Didn't they call it to a melody?

No, not unconscious. No, not unconscious. Not unconscious. No, not unconscious. No, not unconscious. No, not unconscious. I'm sure. But, uh... Anyway. Well, Lawrence said that he was the only one that got along with Bunk, whether that's true or not, I don't know. Lawrence said that he was constantly acting as a go-between between Bunk and the rest of the guys in the band, and that Bunk was mostly irritable and hard to get along with, very temperamental, and felt that they were pretty poor musicians, even Baby.…
Didn't he care for Baby as musicians? That's what I understand.
